# Elfsight

> > Elfsight provides 90+ no-code website widgets for social media integration, engagement, and lead generation without coding required.

Elfsight is a comprehensive widget platform offering free and premium plugins for WordPress, Shopify, and custom websites. The platform specializes in social media feed embeds, engagement tools, and conversion optimization widgets designed for businesses of all sizes.

## Key Topics

- Social Media Integration
- No-Code Widgets
- Instagram Feed
- Facebook Feed
- LinkedIn Feed
- TikTok Feed
- Website Plugins
- Lead Generation
- Engagement Boost
- Responsive Design
- Website Customization
- Free Tools
- Conversion Optimization
- AI Chatbot
- WhatsApp Integration

## Core Platform

- [Elfsight Homepage](https://elfsight.com): Elfsight homepage showcasing 90+ widgets for sales, engagement, and lead generation
- [Widget Directory](https://elfsight.com/widgets): Complete widget directory with free plugins for social media, forms, reviews, and e-commerce
- [Help Center](https://help.elfsight.com): Documentation, FAQs, integrations, and troubleshooting support

## Social Media Feed Widgets

- [Instagram Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/instagram-feed-instashow): Free Instagram Feed widget (InstaShow) for embedding custom feeds with templates
- [Facebook Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/facebook-feed-widget): Facebook Feed widget for embedding posts, photos, videos with no coding required
- [Twitter/X Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/twitter-feed-widget): Twitter/X Feed widget for embedding tweets and testimonials on websites
- [LinkedIn Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/linkedin-feed-widget): LinkedIn Feed widget for credibility building and lead generation on websites
- [TikTok Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/tiktok-feed-widget): TikTok Feed widget for embedding videos and galleries with no coding
- [Social Feed Aggregator](https://elfsight.com/social-feed-widget): Multi-platform social feed aggregator for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and X
- [Pinterest Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/pinterest-feed-widget): Pinterest Feed widget for displaying profiles, pins, and boards with customization
- [RSS Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/rss-feed-widget): Customizable RSS Feed widget for creating news sections on websites

## Engagement & Content Widgets

- [Blog Widget](https://elfsight.com/blog-widget): No-code Blog widget with AI content generation, SEO optimization, and templates
- [Comments Widget](https://elfsight.com/comments-widget): Comments widget for engagement, moderation, and community building on websites
- [Vimeo Gallery Widget](https://elfsight.com/vimeo-video-gallery-widget): Vimeo Gallery widget for embedding videos and playlists without coding

## Social Sharing & Connection Widgets

- [Social Media Icons Widget](https://elfsight.com/social-media-icons-widget): Customizable social media icons widget for driving followers to profiles
- [Social Media Share Buttons](https://elfsight.com/social-media-share-buttons): Social share buttons widget for expanding reach and viral content sharing

## Regional & Niche Platforms

- [Tumblr Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/tumblr-feed-widget): Tumblr Feed widget with customizable layouts for engagement optimization
- [VK Feed Widget](https://elfsight.com/vk-feed-widget): VK Feed widget with customizable themes for content curation and engagement
